description: Builds a PR or digital PR campaign plan from the Press Room catalog within a budget: at most one press release distribution package for the region, plus news site articles ranked for the goal or a goal mix (goal_weights), topic and language, never over the budget. Every line says why it was chosen and carries its item id. With a brand, the brand's weakest audit score can add weight to its goal, and the plan says so. Use this when someone has a budget and wants a press release distribution or PR plan. Do not use for ordering or for an exact price (a quote holds the price). Side effects: none; nothing is quoted or reserved.

brand_id.description: Optional: a brand of this account. Example: "8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"

budget_cents.description: The total budget in US cents; the plan never goes over it. Example: 300000

goal.description: One goal: reputation, seo, ai_visibility or mentions; or send goal_weights; neither uses the goals set in the dashboard. Example: "mentions"

goal_weights.description: A goal mix, each 0 to 100, scaled to 100. Example: {"ai_visibility": 60, "seo": 40}

language.description: Optional: an ISO 639-1 code or its English name. Example: "en"

name: plan_campaign

goal.description: The one goal; left out for a mix

goal_weights.description: The mix used, in percent, summing to 100

summary.description: Plain words at the top: the goal mix used and, with brand_id, the weakest score

title: Plan a campaign
